title: Bank of England flags AI debt and the 'right to intervene'
summary: The Bank of England's Financial Policy Committee said the likelihood that interconnected vulnerabilities in the financial system crystallise has risen, citing the re-escalation of conflict in the Middle East, higher energy prices and government bond yields at their highest since 2008 in some markets. It warned that AI-related debt issuance reached about $450bn by early September, more than double all of 2025, and held the countercyclical capital buffer at 2%. Governor Andrew Bailey said society must keep the right to intervene.
